title: Assistants
intro: One assistant answers on as many channels as you tick — same personality, same instructions, same knowledge. Add a second only when it should behave differently, like the one that takes messages after hours.
channel_whatsapp_note: Replies to messages and voice notes.
channel_telegram_note: Replies to messages on your bot.
channel_webchat_note: Answers the bubble on your website.
role_felix: Overflow · answers when Lena is busy
empty_body: Nobody is answering your line. Create one assistant, give it a greeting and a voice, connect your number, and call yourself to hear it — that takes about two minutes.
offline_title: Phone line offline — every phone assistant is idle
offline_body_after: . WhatsApp assistants are unaffected and still answering.
dialog_name_note: Only you see this name. Callers hear the greeting you write next.
hint_none: Pick at least one channel — an assistant with none can never be reached.
hint_one: One personality, one set of instructions, one knowledge library. Tick more channels and the same assistant answers on all of them.
hint_many: The same personality and knowledge on all {count} — only the medium changes. Voice settings apply to the phone channel only.
install_note: — Signal, SMS, email and Matrix are in the store.
error_title: The agent service is not running
error_body: The web interface is up, but the process that hosts your assistants did not answer on its socket. Calls arriving right now ring through to the business phones instead of being answered.
